units.title: so/such + quite/pretty
units.shortDescription: Такой красивый день — so beautiful или such a beautiful day?
units.theoryHtml:
so усиливает прилагательное и наречие: The film was so boring. such усиливает СУЩЕСТВИТЕЛЬНОЕ (с прилагательным): It was such a boring film. Запомни: such a + прилагательное + существительное — артикль обязателен.

ПравильноНеправильно
so beautifulsuch beautiful
such a beautiful cityso a beautiful city
so many books, so much rainsuch many books

quite/pretty/rather — «довольно»: The hotel is quite good. such перед множественным без a: such nice people.

⚠ Частые ошибки: It was so nice day → such a nice day. He's such tall → so tall. so a long journey → such a long journey.

Мини-диалог:
— How was the trip? — exhausting! Such a long flight, and the seats were so uncomfortable.
— But the views were pretty amazing, right? — Quite!

exercises.prompt: The weather was ___ lovely that we stayed outside all day.
I've got ___ many things to do.

options: It was so a funny joke.
It was such a funny joke.
It was a so funny joke.

exercises.prompt: The exam was ___ difficult than I expected.
exercises.explanation: more difficult — comparative; quite/pretty не ставятся перед comparative.

exercises.prompt: The problem is ___ (настолько) serious that we need help.

units.title: Наречия частотности: always, never + still/yet/already
units.shortDescription: Где ставить always и чем still отличается от yet.
units.theoryHtml:
Наречия частотности (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) стоят ПЕРЕД обычным глаголом, но ПОСЛЕ глагола to be: I usually walk to work. She is always late. He doesn't often cook.

Три слова, которые все путают:

СловоСмыслМесто
stillвсё ещё (продолжается)перед глаголом / после be: He still lives there. He is still here.
yetуже/ещё (ожидание) — в вопросах и отрицанияхВ КОНЦЕ: Have you finished yet? I haven't seen it yet.
alreadyуже (раньше ожидаемого)перед глаголом / в конце (амер.): I've already seen it.

⚠ Частые ошибки: I have yet finished → I have already finished. He is yet here → He is still here. I go always there → I always go there.

Мини-диалог:
— Have you called the bank yet? — I've already called twice. They're still closed. It's Sunday!

exercises.prompt: She ___ drinks coffee in the morning.

exercises.explanation: Вопрос с ожиданием — yet в конце.

exercises.prompt: My grandmother ___ lives in the same house.

options: I go always to the gym.
I always go to the gym.
I go to the gym always usually.
Always I go to the gym.
